title: ID0453752-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / R3 170001589] LEDs are white
description:
Reported behavior/issue: After restarting, the charger has no connection to the SCB and backend. Previously displayed SECC error. Several on-site restarts without success. Outlets are not displayed. LEDs are white. Siemens router only blinks. SIM card has already been checked, it is fine.
Cfast flash needed
